messages:
dana: quick note from the sales kickoff  Pilot customer (EdgeCo) wants SSO + tenant quotas + a 'no surprises' SLA for seat provisioning. they want a solid pilot week.

phil: engineering reality: full quota automation + multi-tenant SSO is ~3w. we can do SAML-only + manual quota enforcement in ~1w.

maya: customer success: EdgeCo's success metric is 'seats ready within business day'. manual ops can work if we guarantee completion times and an oncall owner.

rory: security: audit trails are required. adding basic provisioning audit events is small (+1d) but must be in the pilot.

dana: so choices: (A) SAML-only pilot + ops-assisted quotas + audit events (fast), (B) SAML+quota automation (slower). need to pick to lock schedule.

phil: breakdown: A -> pilot start in 9 business days; B -> pilot start in ~4w. v1 timelines shift accordingly.

jess: ops can support A for two pilots if we get a runbook and a simple admin UI for manual quota toggles. i'll own the rota.

maya: legal asks that any manual workaround be documented in a pilot annex. i'll draft that clause.

dana: proposal: choose A for pilot. commit to delivering quota automation + enhanced RBAC in v1. milestone plan: pilot start +9d, v1 GA target +7w.

phil: engineering will: ship SAML + core audit events in sprint, add feature flag for quota automation, queue automation work for v1 epic.

rory: QA will run a staged rollout (one team within EdgeCo first) and validate audit logs and provisioning SLAs.

jess: i'll publish runbook + manual admin UI spec in 48h and schedule oncall for first 3 weeks.

maya: i'll send pilot annex to EdgeCo today and confirm they accept manual quota enforcement for initial cohort.

dana: action items:
- maya: pilot annex sent (today)
- jess: runbook + admin spec (48h)
- phil: PRD update + backlog (EOD)
- rory: staged QA plan (72h)
- calendar-bot: create milestone check-in Friday 11:00

calendar-bot: "Event created: EdgeCo pilot scope alignment  Friday 11:00"

dana: marking resolved for now. reopen if EdgeCo requires full automation for pilot start. :white_check_mark:
